title: Supplementary code for: A Singularity-Driven Invariant Closure Theory for Traveling Wave Solutions of Nonlinear Partial Differential Equations
description: Exact symbolic audit (692 cases) and independent verification scripts for the invariant closure theory of traveling waves: coefficient systems, Groebner-basis nonexistence certificates, Singular cofactor identities, verification of the found closures and the script that produces the profile figure.
